span.note: WHOSE RESULT THIS IS: ested in separate trial blocks ( Turvey et al., 1970 ; Greene, 1996 ). - 2026-08-26 terminal-a. THE RESULT IS THE CITED WORK'S AND THE CITATION TRAILS THE SENTENCE. A plain noun phrase is the subject of the result verb and the attribution is a bracket at the end - `Neurons within the dorsal temporal pole demonstrated match suppression ... ( Ng et al., 2014 )`. Neither of my two cues could see this shape, so THESE WERE READ RATHER THAN SWEPT: 36 candidates of the shape, 20 read, 11 marked, 9 refused. THE REFUSALS ARE WHY IT IS NOT A CUE: `Aru2012 findings[16]` is the paper's OWN result with a citation supporting the localisation, `Natan2015 findings[3]` ends `consistent with previous findings ( Szymanski et al., 2009 )` where the main clause is the paper's, and `Drieu2019` x3 are `One cannot entirely rule out...` - a limitation, not an attribution. About 55% precise, which is a list to read and not a sweep to run. Q-1119.
